title: Roommates by Day
text: By day, this beetle shares a shelter with frogs and toads. At night, it hunts them.

title: The Adult Beetle
text: It is an adult Epomis ground beetle,

title: The Ride
text: It jumps onto a frog's back and hangs on like a rodeo rider.
nxt: The frog's tongue can only strike forward, so it cannot reach it.

title: The Cut
text: Then the beetle makes a horizontal cut across the lower back.
nxt: Within one to two minutes, the frog stops moving.

title: Poison on the Menu
text: Even green toads, with poison glands in their skin, are on the menu.
nxt: How the beetle copes with the poison, no one knows for sure.
